Troops of Sector 2, Operation Enduring Peace, have killed a suspected terrorist and recovered two motorcycles and a mobile phone during a night encounter with armed men in Wase Local Government Area of Plateau State. The encounter, it was gathered, occurred at about 8 pm on Thursday, when troops deployed at Kukawa, while conducting a night patrol along the Kukawa-Shuwaka-Yelwa Road, ran into a large number of suspected terrorists riding motorcycles. The troops engaged the armed men in a gun battle, killing one of them, while others fled the scene. Items recovered during the operation included two motorcycles and a mobile phone. Military sources said troops had commenced efforts to track down the fleeing suspects and prevent them from regrouping. He stressed that residents’ cooperation was critical to the success of ongoing efforts to combat criminal activities and restore lasting peace across Plateau State. “We assure residents of the military’s continued commitment to protecting lives and property and urge them not to hesitate to share useful information with security agencies,” he added.
